description: A dogleg of a service lane roofed in corrugated tin that drums like gunfire whenever it rains, which is always. Every ground-floor window wears its own cage of rebar and welded mesh; commerce here is conducted through slots. The Cage anchors the lane — steel screen floor to ceiling, a clerk somewhere behind it, a shotgun somewhere behind the clerk. A hand-lettered sign promises OPEN and, unusually, means it.
name: Tin Lane
